data.title: Color Picker
data.tagline: A form control for viewing and choosing a color value
data.description: Use a color picker for a theme, chart series, or drawing tool. Along with the palette, show a copyable value; text and icons still need enough contrast to be readable.

distinctions.label: Select
distinctions.explanation: Color Picker shows a color preview and an exact color value. Select chooses from fixed text options.

avoid: Two clearly defined choices: use color swatch buttons
Color as the only meaning: add text or an icon
Low-contrast text with no stated contrast requirement

lessonPractice.title: Theme settings allow a freely chosen brand color that must be shared precisely and keep button text readable. How should this work?

options.label: Provide a color field, copyable value, live preview, and text-contrast check together
options.feedback: The field supports exploration, the exact value supports reproduction, and contrast validation preserves readability.

options.label: Show only one current-color swatch with no value or input method
options.feedback: Users can see the result but cannot adjust it precisely, copy it, or reproduce the same color elsewhere.

options.label: Accept any color from the field and apply it whenever it looks good to the user
options.feedback: Visual preference does not guarantee readable foreground contrast, so pale or similar colors may hide key actions.

data.agentPrompt: Provide a theme color picker with editable and copyable HEX, plus a live button preview. Validate text contrast before applying, explain failures, and preserve the last valid value. Test keyboard entry, pasted values, and reset.
